semantic.justification: Task76 in progress: original clipboard ResetClip/InitClipPtrs and SharePooledResources retain genuine pool/string/attribute helper identities,source option values and sparse selected-sheet indexes. Clear releases actual formula and attribute owners before sheet removal. Native column4 CloneFormulaCell creates shared code once per shareable span,bulk-inserts actual typed storage and joins boundaries. Default CONTENTS CopyFromClipContext retains native cursor caches,cell values,metadata and deferred listening spans;single-cell column replication handles represented values,strings,empty and grouped formulas. Original temporary/inserting document guards suppress premature subscriptions and broadcasts. No browser fill loop,formula-text reparse,alternate workbook or simulated physical refcount is introduced. Document-level paste/reference completion,real paste undo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance are still pending;this progress record does not certify task76 or full native parity. Task76 pre-paste deletion progress ports SingleColumnSpanSet set/getSpans/swap/empty and the ColumnSpanSet single-column overload;native DeleteCells captures actual formula group extents before shared-context teardown and explicit broadcaster purge,then splits top/bottom boundaries and empties real typed stores in reverse span order. Original document10/table7/column4 pre-deletion cycles sparse source tabs and columns,visits allocated destinations only,and defers broadcasts/listener restoration to CopyFromClipContext. Default CONTENTS preserves destination patterns. Native toSpanArray is reused. Selective date/number deletion requires the unported formatter;skip-empty,nondefault flags and absent rich-edit/note/sparkline stores remain explicit. CellStorageModified formula-group compute cache and stream-valid notifications are unrepresented rather than simulated. Full document copy/paste/reference completion,paste Undo/Redo,EnterBlock and browser acceptance remain pending;this is not task76 completion or full parity. These additions supersede only earlier omissions of these specific pre-deletion/span/listener methods;unconsumed overloads and broader parity remain unverified. Task76 general-copy progress ports original CopyCellsFromClipHandler and CopyTextAttrsFromClipHandler with real typed source blocks,two content/metadata passes,independent native cursor values,context writeback and foreign string re-interning. ScColumn scalar/hinted SetValue/SetRawString/SetFormulaCell overloads retain native defaults,return contracts,broadcast controls and actual group/listener owners. Table2 CopyFromClip validates/clamps the destination and dispatches actual source columns;CONTENTS preserves destination patterns and geometry. ParseBlock now represents its actual container-event template and borrowed node fields;bounded ProcessFormula dispatches real formula pointers and separate non-formula spans. Original column/table/document SetDirtyFromClip,rectangular individual/area BroadcastCells and deferred BroadcastAction use existing bulk owners and actual subscriptions;cached formula results are dirtied only in completion. Matrix,foreign-pool formulas,number-format inheritance,full formatter/notes/edit/drawing services,group-compute cache invalidation and shell/UNO stream notifications remain unrepresented. Native general document/reference orchestration,paste undo/redo and EnterBlock/UI acceptance remain pending;this is not full task76 acceptance or full parity. Task76 adds original copy-reference context values, insertion-only global-name normalization, sparse column sets, ScFormulaCell copy-update/compile metadata and actual document/table/column copy traversal with boundary group joins. Compiled references remain owned by the existing token arrays; no formula-source reparse is used to relocate references. Native false returns, oldest on-move undo formula and optional block-position borrowing are retained. Non-copy shift/move engines and absent names/drawing/printing/validation/embedded/UNO/formatter services remain unrepresented. This prerequisite does not complete document CopyFromClip, paste history, EnterBlock or AutoSum acceptance; whole-module behavior/contract/default parity stays unverified. Task76 adds original InitUndo,InitUndoSelected and AddUndoTab with source-shared pooled resources,empty native names,sparse actual sheet vectors and false/false geometry defaults. ScTable now allocates genuine column width/flag and row height/flag owners independently under original constructor defaults true/true;no fake geometry buffers are allocated when disabled. Native width/height getters,mutators and geometry-copy guards honor actual absent stores. Borrowed browser geometry-range helpers,CopyRowHeight and optimal-height calculation keep their original allocated-geometry caller precondition;casts preserve that boundary without inventing absent ranges. GetClipArea is partitioned unchanged on the same document instance. Empty selected initialization keeps the original one-null-slot result (CALC-262). Source shell-medium URL propagation and unrepresented formatter/drawing/printing services remain unported;native paste history,document CopyFromClip,single-row script/format services and EnterBlock are still pending. No whole-module parity promotion. Task76 adds original table7 CopyOneCellFromClip over prepared actual single-row context values,with native modulo column repetition and existing native column bulk formula-group cloning. Whole-row paste copies original nonhidden source height across the destination range but changes the ManualSize bit only at its first row (CALC-263). GetOriginalHeight preserves native invalid/absent-height fallback. Optional actual row/flag owners are respected. Context admission remains default CONTENTS;conditional formats/drawings and document-level single-row script/format preparation remain unrepresented. Native document CopyFromClip,paste history and EnterBlock/AutoSum are still pending;no whole-module parity promotion. TaskKVGGCR document-copy listening: Native DeleteEmptyBroadcasters visits only actual allocated column owners;no columns or listeners are synthesized. TaskKVGGCR adds the actual native ScTable-owned ScConditionalFormatList default,mutable GetCondFormList lazy allocation,SetCondFormList unique ownership transfer and DeleteConditionalFormat. Managed sheet teardown releases real entries/cache listeners before canonical column attributes. Real date entries,style-string refcounts,replacement,null ownership and document close are covered. Const-overload binding and full table conditional-format copying/rendering/XML remain unported;this is not a full conditional-format UI claim. Native table1 UpdateReference now forwards to the real conditional-format list after column traversal;cache values are reset even for nonintersecting copied cells. Original list UpdateReference prunes empty ranges only in URM_INSDEL. Broader sheet insert/delete/move token/table consumers remain unported and are not replaced by a SetTabNo shortcut. Task76 conditional-index binding ports document/table/column/ScAttrArray AddCondFormatData/AddCondFormat over the actual canonical attribute runs. Valid rows always have the real default pattern;run clipping,index union,unsigned keys,idempotent insertion,existing attributes and holder destruction are retained. Conditional copy orchestration,style migration,painting and full paste history remain unverified. Task76 conditional-index removal binds actual document/table/column/attribute owners:zero clears all indices while retaining an explicit empty item;nonzero erases only the first matching index,including initializer-list duplicates. Existing attributes survive,and table removal clamps to allocated columns without allocating a new tail. Scalar SetValue and literal SetTextCell bodies are partitioned onto the same actual owners in column3/documen7;native defaults,stores,listener order and text admission are unchanged. Full conditional copy/style migration and paste/history remain pending. Task76 native UndoToColumn/UndoToTable restore the edited payload,formula-only cells outside its rows/columns,whole conditional-format ownership,and full-axis raw geometry/manual breaks with actual null geometry checks. Marked copying retains the original null-mark-data asymmetry (CALC-265). Real table5 page/manual sets,ordered set value/move binding,stream-validity state/document locking and width-change pagination invalidation are represented. Named-expression maps,pagination/device calculation,full XML streaming and native document-level Undo/paste/history orchestration remain unported;no fake owner or alternate workbook is introduced. Original CopyToTable,CopyConditionalFormat and scalar/range GetRowHeight signatures execute in table2 on this same owner. Represented destructor bindings release default attributes,conditional listeners and actual columns in native member order. Geometry-only five-argument CopyToTable is removed. Native merged-anchor query follows document10 to table7,inline column.hxx and actual ScAttrArray runs. Absent sheets,invalid or unallocated columns return false without allocating columns;stored runs use Search and their actual ATTR_MERGE spans,while an empty attribute array uses the document default pattern. Overlap flags alone do not constitute a merged anchor. These are prerequisites for original CopyOneCellFromClip;document-level paste and its formatter/script/history services remain incomplete. DeleteSelection forwards the native broadcast defaulttrue through actual allocated columns. No default-tail cells or geometry are invented.
